prompt:
CONCEPT REFERENCE ONLY (art direction study, not a game asset). A gameplay-style screenshot mood study for a modern 2D pixel-art roguelike action game, same world, same steep three-quarter top-down camera and same modern high-detail pixel-art style as the attached image (crisp pixels, rich mid-tones, painterly light), but a completely different location - do not reuse the attached composition. Camera: orthographic, the floor is seen from above on a square grid; every wall, building and large structure shows its tall FRONT face (about two tiles high) so characters can walk behind them. Scale: the screen shows about 30 by 17 floor tiles and a character is about one and a half tiles tall. The middle of the screen is an open, calm, low-contrast floor that stays readable for combat; height, props and light sources sit around the edges.

Scene: the forecourt in front of the great gate of the liquor empire, at night. The north edge is a massive grim stone curtain wall with a gatehouse in its center: the wall front face is tall (about three tiles of dressed stone blocks with arrow slits and a plinth), the battlement walkway and crenellations are seen from above along its top, two squat towers flank the gate. The iron portcullis is half raised and warm amber light spills out of the gate tunnel onto the ground - the brightest point of the scene. Tattered banners with a goblet emblem hang on the wall front, torches in iron brackets beside the gate. The arena floor is a muddy road with deep cart ruts and patches of worn cobbles, calm and readable. West and east edges are low stone guard walls with flat tops visible, a wooden toll booth with a toll table and a lantern, a wagon loaded with oak barrels, stacked crates and sacks, a wooden barricade of crossed stakes, a stone horse trough. Along the south edge runs a narrow moat of black water with a short wooden drawbridge leading off-screen.

Lighting: overall dark blue-gray night, deep shadows, slight vignette. Strong warm amber pools from the gate tunnel, the two wall torches and the toll lantern, soft light falloff on the mud, bright specular glints on puddles in the ruts and rim highlights on barrel hoops, stone edges and the portcullis bars. One small dark-coated figure with a wide-brimmed hat stands in the middle of the forecourt; a few slouching, half-drunk gate guards with halberds stand near the gate.

Palette: charcoal and cool slate grays with subtle blue-gray in the shadows, warm umber wood, dirty pale plaster or stone, and a single warm amber/ember accent for every light source. No saturated blue, green, purple or red. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no HUD, no watermark, no frame.
